key_family: 57 shared 1U keycaps; retain existing guided wide key

acrylic_retention.material_target: machined aluminum prototype collar; alloy and bearing/preload must be qualified
acrylic_retention.contact_basis: Actual C02 mesh rays find six of 24 angular samples on the surviving z12 acrylic shoulder at each axis. Inner rebates are lower. Contact is sector-supported, not uniform bearing.

diagnostic: manufacturing/runs/travel-diagnostic-C01/diagnostic.json reproduced old 4.5 mm skirt interference at 3.2 mm; temporary 4.8/5.0/5.2 variants cleared the modeled cover. This contract chooses 5.0 mm before construction.
acceptance: All 58 saved keycaps must clear their cover, flange and plate at every listed travel sample.
Existing stem insertion and receiver dimensions must remain unchanged; all guides must clear.
A deliberately excessive 6.0 mm travel must still be rejected by the collision predicate.
The full current representative family set must pass topology, wall screening and STL re-import.
limits: The cover is a custom modeled carrier, not a manufacturer-authenticated factory housing.
No commercial switch modification is authorized. Physical samples must be checked at their own measured stop.
Clearance is not physical insertion/retention, material strength or manufacturing approval.
Existing Full HD imagery remains bound to Revision B and does not portray C03.
